items.author: Scott Agness
items.body_excerpt:
Sophie Cunningham with the steal + basket to end the 1Q, tying the game at 31. Both teams shooting > 54%.

Really fun start so far. Pace and scoring favors the Fever. Clark already has 11pts, including three 3s. Wilson has 14pts.

items.title: What a back and forth first quarter.
items.author: Steve Jones
items.body_excerpt:
What a back and forth first quarter. 

A'ja Wilson with 14 on 5 of 5 shooting, Aces shooting 66% 

Fever guards have come out swinging, Clark with 11, Mitchell with 7, Boston with 8. 26 of Fever's 31

Who can establish tempo, Fever pace or can the Aces execute and contain?

items.title: 31-31 after one quarter thanks to a steal and score from Sophie Cunningham just before the buzzer. Aces are 9/11 on two-point looks. Fever have to defend the interior better. And yet, Fever big three were all fantastic and made 11 shots collectively.
